title: Of Mice and Men
author: John Steinbeck
summary: George and Lennie are migrant workers in 1930s California, one sharp and wary, the other huge and simple. They share a dream of owning a bit of land, but trouble follows Lennie wherever they go.
readIf: you want a very short, powerful story about friendship and fragile hope.
skipIf: you dislike sad endings or cruel treatment of animals and outsiders.

pairings.reason: The author's epic of poor migrants in the same era, with a wider lens.
Another Steinbeck novel set in California, richer and more sweeping.
Another American classic about prejudice, told with more warmth and humour.
